author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/12/2018: APTI, BBOX, SAP, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.42%
AAPL: -2.46%
IBM: -0.43%
CSCO: -0.49%
GOOG: -1.24%
Tech stocks were mostly lower early Monday. Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Apptio ( APTI ), which was surging by over 51% after an affiliate of Vista Equity Partners, a private equity firm investing in technology-enabled businesses, agreed to acquire the company in a $1.94 billion all-cash deal.
(+) Black Box ( BBOX ) was advancing by more than 21% after it unveiled a definitive merger deal with AGC Networks Pte. Ltd., the Singaporean subsidiary of global solutions integrator AGC Networks Ltd., under which AGC will acquire the IT infrastructure products and services company.
(-) SAP ( SAP ) was down by more than 4% after it agreed to acquire all the outstanding shares of Qualtrics International for $8 billion in cash.
